parameters.query: WITH config AS ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) AS values FROM settings WHERE key = ANY (ARRAY['REGION','LANGUAGE','COLLECTION_WINDOW_HOURS','MAX_RESULTS_PER_QUERY','MAX_QUERIES_PER_RUN','SHORT_MAX_DURATION','YOUTUBE_SEARCH_DAILY_CALL_LIMIT','YOUTUBE_SEARCH_QUOTA_COST','YOUTUBE_VIDEOS_LIST_QUOTA_COST'])), started_run AS ( INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (workflow, status, metadata) SELECT '01 - TrendLens - YouTube Data Collector', 'running', jsonb_build_object('region', values -> 'REGION', 'language', values -> 'LANGUAGE', 'collection_window_hours', values -> 'COLLECTION_WINDOW_HOURS', 'max_results_per_query', values -> 'MAX_RESULTS_PER_QUERY', 'max_queries_per_run', values -> 'MAX_QUERIES_PER_RUN', 'search_quota_cost', values -> 'YOUTUBE_SEARCH_QUOTA_COST') FROM config RETURNING id, started_at), ranked_queries AS ( SELECT q.id AS query_id, q.query_text, q.sample_group, q.language, q.region, c.slug AS category_slug, CASE WHEN q.sample_group = 'recent' THEN 'date' ELSE 'viewCount' END AS search_order, to_char((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(hours => (config.values ->> 'COLLECTION_WINDOW_HOURS')::integer)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS published_after, LEAST(COALESCE(q.max_results_override, (config.values ->> 'MAX_RESULTS_PER_QUERY')::integer), 50) AS max_results, (config.values ->> 'SHORT_MAX_DURATION')::integer AS short_max_duration, (config.values ->> 'YOUTUBE_VIDEOS_LIST_QUOTA_COST')::integer AS youtube_videos_list_quota_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY q.last_collected_at ASC NULLS FIRST, q.priority, q.id) AS collection_order, LEAST(GREATEST((config.values ->> 'MAX_QUERIES_PER_RUN')::integer, 1), GREATEST((config.values ->> 'YOUTUBE_SEARCH_DAILY_CALL_LIMIT')::integer, 1)) AS query_limit FROM collection_queries q JOIN categories c ON c.id = q.category_id CROSS JOIN config WHERE q.is_active), selected_queries AS ( SELECT query_id, query_text, sample_group, language, region, category_slug, search_order, published_after, max_results, short_max_duration, youtube_videos_list_quota_cost FROM ranked_queries WHERE collection_order <= query_limit) SELECT started_run.id AS pipeline_run_id, started_run.started_at AS run_started_at, selected_queries.* FROM selected_queries CROSS JOIN started_run;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT pr.*
  FROM pipeline_runs pr
  WHERE pr.id = $1::bigint
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    target.id,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM video_collection_matches m WHERE m.pipeline_run_id = target.id) AS matches_recorded,
    (
      SELECT count(DISTINCT m.video_id)
      FROM video_collection_matches m
      JOIN videos v ON v.id = m.video_id
      WHERE m.pipeline_run_id = target.id
        AND v.created_at >= target.started_at
    ) AS new_videos,
    (
      SELECT count(DISTINCT s.id)
      FROM video_snapshots s
      JOIN video_collection_matches m
        ON m.video_id = s.video_id
       AND m.pipeline_run_id = target.id
      WHERE s.collected_at >= date_trunc('milliseconds', target.started_at)
        AND s.collected_at < date_trunc('milliseconds', target.started_at) + interval '1 millisecond'
    ) AS snapshots_collected
  FROM target
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET
    finished_at = COALESCE(pipeline_runs.finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
    status = CASE
      WHEN pipeline_runs.items_failed > 0 AND pipeline_runs.items_processed = 0 THEN 'failed'
      WHEN pipeline_runs.items_failed > 0 THEN 'partial'
      ELSE 'success'
    END,
    duration_seconds = COALESCE(
      pipeline_runs.duration_seconds,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - pipeline_runs.started_at))
    ),
    metadata = pipeline_runs.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
      'matches_recorded', counts.matches_recorded,
      'new_videos', counts.new_videos,
      'duplicate_videos', GREATEST(pipeline_runs.items_processed - counts.new_videos, 0),
      'snapshots_collected', counts.snapshots_collected
    )
  FROM counts
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id = counts.id
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT
  id AS pipeline_run_id,
  workflow,
  status,
  items_received,
  items_processed,
  items_skipped,
  items_failed,
  api_calls,
  quota_units_estimated,
  duration_seconds,
  metadata,
  started_at,
  finished_at
FROM updated
WHERE id = $1::bigint;

WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS pipeline_run_id,
    (SELECT started_at FROM pipeline_runs WHERE id = $1::bigint) AS run_started_at,
    $3::bigint AS query_id,
    $4::integer AS search_rank,
    $5::text AS external_id,
    $6::text AS channel_id,
    NULLIF($7::text, '') AS channel_name,
    $8::text AS title,
    NULLIF($9::text, '') AS description,
    $10::timestamptz AS published_at,
    NULLIF($11::text, '') AS duration_iso,
    NULLIF($12::text, '') AS api_language,
    $13::text AS region,
    $14::text AS configured_language,
    $15::integer AS short_max_duration,
    NULLIF($16::text, '')::bigint AS views,
    NULLIF($17::text, '')::bigint AS likes,
    NULLIF($18::text, '')::bigint AS comments,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($19::text, ''), '[]') AS tags_json
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    raw.*,
    CASE
      WHEN duration_iso ~ '^P([0-9]+D)?(T([0-9]+H)?([0-9]+M)?([0-9]+S)?)?$'
      THEN COALESCE((substring(duration_iso FROM '([0-9]+)D'))::integer, 0) * 86400
         + COALESCE((substring(duration_iso FROM '([0-9]+)H'))::integer, 0) * 3600
         + COALESCE((substring(duration_iso FROM '([0-9]+)M'))::integer, 0) * 60
         + COALESCE((substring(duration_iso FROM '([0-9]+)S'))::integer, 0)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS duration_seconds,
    normalize_language_code(api_language) AS normalized_api_language,
    COALESCE(normalize_language_code(configured_language), 'pt') AS normalized_target_language
  FROM raw
), prepared AS (
  SELECT
    normalized.*,
    duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND duration_seconds <= short_max_duration AS is_candidate,
    CASE
      WHEN duration_seconds IS NOT NULL
       AND duration_seconds <= short_max_duration
       AND (
         lower(title || ' ' || COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%#shorts%'
         OR lower(tags_json) ~ '"#?shorts"'
       )
      THEN 'high'
      WHEN duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND duration_seconds <= 60 THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'low'
    END AS short_confidence,
    CASE
      WHEN normalized_api_language IS NULL THEN 'uncertain'
      WHEN language_matches_target(normalized_api_language, normalized_target_language) THEN 'eligible'
      ELSE 'rejected'
    END AS initial_language_eligibility
  FROM normalized
), existing_before AS (
  SELECT video.id
    FROM videos video
    JOIN prepared
      ON video.platform = 'youtube'
     AND video.external_id = prepared.external_id
), video_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO videos (
    platform,
    external_id,
    channel_id,
    channel_name,
    title,
    description,
    url,
    published_at,
    duration_seconds,
    language,
    api_language,
    target_language,
    detected_language,
    language_confidence,
    language_detection_source,
    language_eligibility,
    language_evaluated_at,
    language_detection_attempts,
    language_retry_after,
    region,
    short_confidence
  )
  SELECT
    'youtube',
    external_id,
    channel_id,
    channel_name,
    title,
    description,
    'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=' || external_id,
    published_at,
    duration_seconds,
    normalized_api_language,
    normalized_api_language,
    normalized_target_language,
    normalized_api_language,
    CASE WHEN normalized_api_language IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN normalized_api_language IS NOT NULL THEN 'youtube_api' ELSE 'unknown' END,
    initial_language_eligibility,
    CASE WHEN normalized_api_language IS NOT NULL THEN run_started_at ELSE NULL END,
    0,
    NULL,
    region,
    short_confidence
  FROM prepared
  WHERE is_candidate
  ON CONFLICT (platform, external_id) DO UPDATE
  SET channel_id = EXCLUDED.channel_id,
      channel_name = EXCLUDED.channel_name,
      title = EXCLUDED.title,
      description = EXCLUDED.description,
      url = EXCLUDED.url,
      published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at,
      duration_seconds = EXCLUDED.duration_seconds,
      api_language = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.api_language, videos.api_language),
      target_language = EXCLUDED.target_language,
      language = CASE
        WHEN EXCLUDED.api_language IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.language
        ELSE videos.language
      END,
      detected_language = CASE
        WHEN EXCLUDED.api_language IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.detected_language
        ELSE videos.detected_language
      END,
      language_confidence = CASE
        WHEN EXCLUDED.api_language IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.language_confidence
        ELSE videos.language_confidence
      END,
      language_detection_source = CASE
        WHEN EXCLUDED.api_language IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.language_detection_source
        ELSE videos.language_detection_source
      END,
      language_eligibility = CASE
        WHEN EXCLUDED.api_language IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.language_eligibility
        ELSE videos.language_eligibility
      END,
      language_evaluated_at = CASE
        WHEN EXCLUDED.api_language IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.language_evaluated_at
        ELSE videos.language_evaluated_at
      END,
      language_retry_after = CASE
        WHEN EXCLUDED.api_language IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE videos.language_retry_after
      END,
      region = EXCLUDED.region,
      short_confidence = EXCLUDED.short_confidence
  RETURNING id
), snapshot_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO video_snapshots (
    video_id, collected_at, views, likes, comments
  )
  SELECT
    video_upsert.id,
    prepared.run_started_at,
    prepared.views,
    prepared.likes,
    prepared.comments
  FROM video_upsert
  CROSS JOIN prepared
  WHERE prepared.views IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (video_id, collected_at) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, video_id
), match_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO video_collection_matches (
    pipeline_run_id, collection_query_id, video_id, search_rank, matched_at
  )
  SELECT
    prepared.pipeline_run_id,
    prepared.query_id,
    video_upsert.id,
    prepared.search_rank,
    prepared.run_started_at
  FROM video_upsert
  CROSS JOIN prepared
  ON CONFLICT (pipeline_run_id, collection_query_id, video_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), run_update AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
     SET items_received = items_received + 1,
         items_processed = items_processed + CASE
           WHEN prepared.is_candidate AND prepared.views IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         items_skipped = items_skipped + CASE
           WHEN prepared.is_candidate AND prepared.views IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    FROM prepared
   WHERE pipeline_runs.id = prepared.pipeline_run_id
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.id
)
SELECT
  prepared.external_id,
  prepared.duration_seconds,
  prepared.short_confidence,
  prepared.is_candidate,
  prepared.normalized_api_language AS api_language,
  prepared.normalized_target_language AS target_language,
  prepared.initial_language_eligibility AS language_eligibility,
  prepared.is_candidate AND prepared.views IS NOT NULL AS processed,
  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_before)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM video_upsert) AS new_video,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snapshot_insert) AS snapshot_inserted,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM match_insert) AS match_recorded,
  (SELECT id FROM run_update) AS pipeline_run_id
FROM prepared;
